name: Mont Blanc Ascent
summary: The classic first alpine summit: the Goûter route from Saint-Gervais, with a skills day on the Mer de Glace, an acclimatisation night at 3,842 m and a sunrise on the roof of Western Europe.
highlights: Aiguille du Midi cable car ascent

itinerary.title: Chamonix · skills on the Mer de Glace
itinerary.detail: Meet the group, kit check and crampon technique on a lower glacier of the Mer de Glace, then an evening briefing over a fondue.

itinerary.title: Aiguille du Midi · mixed ground
itinerary.detail: Ride the cable car to 3,842 m, practise on mixed terrain and short roped climbing, and sleep high at the Albert 1er hut.

itinerary.title: Goûter route · summit day
itinerary.detail: Cross the Grand Couloir roped before dawn, climb the Dôme du Goûter and reach the summit for sunrise. Descend to the Couvercle hut.

itinerary.title: Chamonix · debrief
itinerary.detail: Walk out through the aiguilles, gear return and a closing dinner with your guide.

name: Matterhorn · Hörnli Ridge
summary: Four days on the most photographed mountain in the world. The Hörnli ridge with fixed lines, an early start to beat the crowds and full crampon-and-axe technique on the Matterhornhorn.

itinerary.title: Zermatt · acclimatisation
itinerary.detail: Weather briefing, rope work refresher and a 2,600 m ascent to the Trift glacier for movement on snow.

itinerary.title: Hörnli hut
itinerary.detail: Train on the Trift glacier, then move to the Hörnli hut for an early night.

itinerary.title: Summit day
itinerary.detail: Leave at 03:00, climb the fixed-line ridge and summit around 07:00 with the Matterhornhorn scramble at the top.

itinerary.title: Reserve day
itinerary.detail: A full spare day held for weather, plus a descent clinic and an evening in Zermatt.

name: Island Peak & Everest Base Camp
summary: The Khumbu trek to base camp followed by a first 6,000 m summit: crampons, a glacier on the Lhotse face and a summit at dawn above the icefall.
highlights: Crampon training with a Sherpa guide
Summit night in a four-season tent
includes: Tea houses and full board in trek

itinerary.title: Kathmandu to Namche
itinerary.detail: Land in Kathmandu, then fly to Lukla and trek into the Khumbu with two acclimatisation nights in Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Base camp
itinerary.detail: Trek to Deboche and Everest Base Camp, with rest days at Namche and Dingboche.

itinerary.title: Crampon training
itinerary.detail: Skills on the Chhukung glacier: front-pointing, axe placement and crampon walking in fixed lines.

itinerary.title: Island Peak base camp
itinerary.detail: Cross the Lhotse La, establish base camp at 5,100 m and rest before the push.

itinerary.title: Summit
itinerary.detail: The headwall at 6,000 m, a ridge crossing and a 06:00 summit, then back to base camp for a well-earned Everest beer.

itinerary.title: Out
itinerary.detail: Retreat through Tengboche, fly out from Lukla and a final night in Kathmandu.

name: Ama Dablam
summary: Considered the most beautiful mountain in the Himalaya and one of the most technical trekking peaks. A three-week climb with Sherpa guides on steep ice, mixed ground and the infamous summit ridge.

itinerary.title: Approach to yak camp
itinerary.detail: Fly to Lukla and trek the classic Khumbu route to a comfortable camp below the southwest face.

itinerary.title: Skills & acclimatisation
itinerary.detail: Ice-climbing sessions below camp, rest days and a careful check of the weather window.

itinerary.title: Camp 1 and 2
itinerary.detail: Move through fixed lines on the glacier to Camp 2 at 5,800 m.

itinerary.title: Summit push
itinerary.detail: A 02:00 start, the mixed ground to 6,500 m and the summit ridge with the full south-east face beneath you.

itinerary.title: Reserve & exit
itinerary.detail: Weather reserve, then descend through Namche and Lukla with a closing dinner in Kathmandu.

name: Denali · West Buttress
summary: Twenty-three days of glaciated ridge, a 20,000 ft carry and one of the most serious mountain environments on earth. Support team, sled hauling and the full permit system managed for you.
includes: Sled, rope and full technical kit

itinerary.title: Talkeetna · logistics
itinerary.detail: Gear check, food packing into sleds and a final weather and rope briefing.

itinerary.title: Glacier skills
itinerary.detail: Kahiltna glacier training: rope travel, crevasse rescue, sled techniques and a rest day.

itinerary.title: Kahiltna to 11,000 ft
itinerary.detail: Carry loads up the glacier through icefall and onto the moraine.

itinerary.title: High camp
itinerary.detail: Move to 14,000 ft on the west buttress, carrying the cache and setting the high camp.

itinerary.title: Summit window
itinerary.detail: Push the ridge in a staged attempt with full crevasse-field discipline and oxygen reserve.

itinerary.title: Descent and pack-out
itinerary.detail: Descend the buttress, break camp and leave the Denali valley with a debrief in Talkeetna.

name: Aconcagua · Normal Route
summary: The highest mountain outside Asia, climbed on the classic normal route with two acclimatisation rotations, mule-supported carries to base camp and a summit at the head of the Fluvial Valley.
highlights: Sunrise on the Valle de las Vacas

itinerary.title: Mendoza · trek to Plaza de Mulas
itinerary.detail: Permits, mule loading and a slow approach up the Horcones valley to base camp at 4,300 m.

itinerary.title: First rotation
itinerary.detail: Move to Camp 1 at 4,950 m, then rest and sleep high to test acclimatisation.

itinerary.title: Second rotation
itinerary.detail: Move to Cólera at 5,200 m and Nido de Cóndores at 5,570 m, sleeping higher than ever before.

itinerary.title: Summit
itinerary.detail: A 04:00 start, the Canaleta to the summit ridge and the traverse to 6,961 m with the whole Americas below.

itinerary.title: Descent
itinerary.detail: Back down to Horcones and a celebratory asado in Mendoza.

name: Haute Route · Ski Traverse
summary: Seven days across the high Alps on skis: glacier travel, couloirs, ski mountaineering skills and the Matterhorn north side as the finale.
highlights: Skiing the couloirs of the Aiguille Verte
includes: Skins, avalanche kit and group equipment

itinerary.title: Chamonix · skills
itinerary.detail: Avalanche rescue, rope work for glacier travel and the first skins on the Grands Montets.

itinerary.title: Aiguille Verte to Trient
itinerary.detail: Three days of classic Haute Route skiing, long traverses and hut evenings.

itinerary.title: Stockji to Zermatt
itinerary.detail: The technical heart of the route: Stecknibble, jumbled glacier and the historic Butaneen descent.

itinerary.title: Zermatt
itinerary.detail: Optional Matterhorn north face descent, then gear return and après.

name: Introduction to Alpine Climbing
summary: Our flagship beginner course. Five days of glacier travel, rope work, crampons and a guaranteed first summit day on a 4,000er if conditions allow — no prior mountain experience needed.
highlights: Rope team travel on a glacier

itinerary.title: Chamonix · kit and movement
itinerary.detail: Fitting crampons and axe, then movement drills on easy glacier snow.

itinerary.title: Rope work and belaying
itinerary.detail: Tying in, running belays and rappelling on the Mer de Glace.

itinerary.title: Glacier travel
itinerary.detail: Roped travel, crevasse rescue systems and a navigation exercise in poor visibility.

itinerary.title: Summit attempt
itinerary.detail: A 4,000 m peak chosen on the day by the guide, with a dawn start and a long descent.

itinerary.title: Wrap-up
itinerary.detail: Debrief, next-steps advice and an evening in Chamonix.

name: Lyngen Alps Ski Safari
summary: Polar light, midnight sun and endless north-facing powder. A week ski-touring the Lyngen Alps above the Arctic Circle, with glacier crossings and coastal descents to the fjords.

itinerary.title: Tromsø · arrival
itinerary.detail: Kit fitting, weather window planning and a short evening ski on Kvaløya.

itinerary.title: Lyngen Alps
itinerary.detail: Five days of touring the alpine faces, roped glacier crossings and long north-side descents.

itinerary.title: Fjord exit
itinerary.detail: A final summit under the midnight sun and a boat back to Tromsø.

name: Kilimanjaro · Machame Route
summary: The Roof of Africa on the classic Machame route: rainforest, moorland, alpine desert and a summit ridge at 05,899 m, with a strong acclimatisation profile and a full support team.

itinerary.title: Forest to Shira plateau
itinerary.detail: From the rainforest through the heather moorland to the Shira plateau at 3,800 m.

itinerary.title: Lava Tower and Barranco
itinerary.detail: A strong acclimatisation day to 4,600 m, then a high traverse over the Shira plateau.

itinerary.title: Summit night
itinerary.detail: A midnight start to Stella Point on the crater rim for sunrise, then Uhuru Peak at 5,895 m.

itinerary.title: Descent and out
itinerary.detail: A fast descent through the Mweka forest and a closing dinner in Arusha.
